purpose: Test the recovered Apple raster coefficient model through X-only, Y-only, and combined viewport clipping without the wide-primitive saturation that confounded run 30654181785.

sourceEvidence.fractionalQuantizer: ((coordinateMantissa + 2) // 4) * 4, i.e. 1/256 pixel with positive half-step ties upward
sourceEvidence.historicalCombinedClipInterpretation: The 16386-to-32768-pixel geometry crossed a fixed wide-primitive saturation boundary, so it is retained as saturation evidence and is not reused as a clean clipping gate.

hypothesis.statement: After exact power-of-two scaling, viewport clipping preserves the frozen two-stage X coefficient bit pattern for every measured width, height, and fresh varying witness.
hypothesis.powerScalingInvariant: For each variant, the X extent and endpoint difference are divided by the same power of two. Multiplying height by eight changes numerator and determinant by the same exact power. The delta, opposite-edge, and determinant significands presented to the frozen two-stage model therefore remain unchanged.
hypothesis.selectorInvariant: Each scaled determinant differs from its measured determinant only by an exact power of two, so its normalized 25-bit selector index is the frozen resolved value.
hypothesis.fractionalGridInvariant: Every generated vertex coordinate is an exact multiple of 1/256 pixel, the exhaustive measured Apple setup grid, so no unmeasured coordinate rounding policy is introduced.
hypothesis.falsification: A centered clipped variant rejects the frozen coefficient if no exact binary32 plane constant can reproduce its two same-tile 30-pixel pull baselines. No post-capture coefficient fit or tolerance is permitted.

capture.zeroOriginControlPurpose: Separates exact power scaling from the centered-varying precision intervention.
capture.centeredControlPurpose: Proves that translating both endpoint varyings by negative one-half of their exact difference preserves the frozen coefficient before any clipping result is interpreted.
capture.centeredVaryingPurpose: Keeps the visible plane close to zero so adjacent binary32 coefficient candidates are observationally distinguishable after the original endpoints are clipped away.
capture.coverageCarrier: R32Float additive one-per-instance count, cleared and verified independently for every width batch and variant

claimBoundary.passEstablishes: Exact coefficient transfer through axis-isolated clipping for the complete measured 8192-by-4 determinant matrix, fourteen fresh varying witnesses, and the frozen 1/256 setup grid at saturation-free coordinates.
passDoesNotEstablish: a compact selector law outside the measured finite tables
